prompt: On the first Saturday, rain moves drop-off indoors. A member brings apple cores and an empty bucket at 10 a.m. What can the member accomplish?
promptZh: 每月第一個星期六，回收因下雨改到室內。有位會員上午十點帶來蘋果核和一個空桶。他可以怎麼做？

options.text: Leave the scraps and fill the bucket at the hall.
options.zh: 在市場大廳回收廚餘，並裝一桶成品堆肥。
options.whyZh: 大廳可收廚餘，但不發放成品堆肥。

options.text: Leave neither item until the next Saturday.
options.zh: 這次什麼都不交，兩件事都等下星期六再辦。
options.whyZh: 十點在回收時段內，今天的大廳可收蘋果核。

options.text: Leave the scraps at the hall and return to the shed next Saturday for compost.
options.zh: 把廚餘交給大廳志工，下星期六再到小屋領堆肥。
options.whyZh: 時間與廚餘都符合室內回收；成品不在大廳發放，因改到室內而沒領到者可下星期六補領。

options.text: Leave the scraps at the shed today and take the bucket to the hall next Saturday.
options.zh: 今天把廚餘放在小屋，下星期六帶桶子到市場大廳。
options.whyZh: 今天應去大廳交廚餘，補領成品在小屋，不是在大廳。

explanationZh: 時間與廚餘都符合室內回收；成品不在大廳發放，因改到室內而沒領到者可下星期六補領。
evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable. | If the shed is closed because of heavy rain, check the chalkboard by the gate. When it reads “Indoor drop-off”, bring your scraps to the market hall during the same hours. When it reads “Cancelled”, take everything home. Neither sign changes what the volunteers accept. | Finished compost becomes available on the first Saturday of each month. Bring a separate bucket to collect it. In the market hall, volunteers can take incoming scraps but cannot give out finished compost. If scrap drop-off moves indoors on a compost collection day, the finished-compost collection is postponed; collect your share at the shed the following Saturday.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指出席領取成品堆肥，不是送來廚餘。
